'''Meriones''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as an aide to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of ''[[Leveler]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he was stationed aboard ''[[Leveler]]'' when he reported to the Captain that he received a coded message from [[Hallena Devis]]. After giving the captain the news about the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist army]] increasing on [[JanFathal]], he disliked Gilad's belief that Meriones had only gotten his position due to family connections in the fleet.
